task_completion.description: The agent successfully launches the CoppeliaSim application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CoppeliaSim GUI window is visible on the desktop.

task_completion.description: The agent writes or executes code that initiates a connection via the ZMQ Remote API.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code editor or terminal showing 'coppelia.zmqRemoteApi' import or client initialization.

task_completion.description: The agent executes at least three distinct motion profiles for the robot arm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The robot arm is seen in different poses across multiple screenshots, or code shows loops/functions for 3+ distinct trajectories.

task_completion.description: The agent implements logic to calculate instantaneous power using joint torques and velocities.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code showing the calculation 'torque * velocity' or 'abs(torque * velocity)' within a simulation loop.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the per-timestep data to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or code showing the saving of data to /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/energy_profile.csv.

task_completion.description: The agent saves aggregate energy statistics to the specified JSON path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or code showing the saving of data to /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/energy_report.json.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the CoppeliaSim environment rather than just creating dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the CoppeliaSim simulation running (play button active or robot moving) while code is executing.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type the energy values into the output files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent uses programming logic (Python/ZMQ) to write the files rather than a text editor to manually fill in numbers.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed three different movements.
integrity.visual_evidence: Code or visual simulation states show different target positions or joint configurations for each of the three profiles.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use the ZMQ Remote API to communicate with CoppeliaSim. It must execute at least 3 distinct motion profiles. The required output files are exactly /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/energy_profile.csv (containing torque, velocity, and |torque x velocity|) and /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/energy_report.json (containing aggregate stats).
